messages:
maria: Quick FYI — planning to pin aegis-lite@v2 to the model catalog tonight during a quiet window (22:00 PST -> 23:00 PST). Need: one smoke checker, one rollback-ready owner, and someone to watch perf/dashboard. Rollback plan: revert alias to aegis-lite@v1 + restart router. Ping if you can take smoke or rollback. @sam @kevin

sam: I can take smoke. What exactly should I run? any test cmds?

maria: Thanks @sam. Quick smoke checklist:
- run smoke job: ./tools/smoke.sh aegis-lite-v2 --quick
- run perf query: ./infra/query_latency.sh aegis-lite-v2 --p99
- validate logs: kubectl logs deploy/model-catalog -n prod | grep 'aegis-lite-v2' -A5
Use staging pin link: https://catalog.internal/redwood/pins/aegis-lite-v2
Expect model to be live ~22:05 after rollout.

kevin: I'll be rollback owner. If smoke fails, I'll rollback alias to v1:
1) catalogcli alias swap --model aegis-lite --to v1
2) k rollout restart deployment/router -n prod
I'll monitor infra alerts.

jess: PR for catalog metadata merged -> https://gh.redwood/repo/pull/4321 : had extra tags for quantization profile. CI passed.

anita: I'll watch perf dashboard + traces. Which dashboard link should I use?

maria: @anita this one: https://dash.redwood/internal/model/aegis-lite-v2/perf (alert thresholds set at 2x baseline p99). Also watch token_cost and error_rate panels.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks complete: infra quota OK, registry image present, no blocking PRs (run id 98765). :robot_face: 

sam: Starting smoke at 22:06 PST. I'll paste quick results here.

sam: smoke: generation sanity ok, sample latency p95 420ms, p99 850ms -> within threshold. No errors in logs in first 5 mins. :+1: 

kevin: Observed a small spike in router error at 22:12 -> looks transient, back to normal at 22:15. No rollback needed.

maria: Thanks everyone. Keeping the pin for 24h before making default. If any regressions, @kevin please action rollback. I'll post a short post-rollout summary tomorrow.

anita: Noted, alerts still green. I'll file a short perf note in the runbook later.

jess: Tagging docs team for a model-card update.

sam: All good from ops side. Closing thread.
